profile.name: Sugeeth Jayaraj S A
bio: Hi, I'm Sugeeth! I love to innovate and make cool new projects. I've worked with VEX Robotics kits, built automation methods using iOS Shortcuts, and set up numerous websites across platforms.

I'm not just a developer—I'm a founder and a leader. Whether it's drafting the governance rules for Project Troopers, designing award-winning graphics for The Corridor Initiative, or configuring Linux and ChromeOS on old hardware, I dive deep into every challenge.

As an ENFJ-T, I believe in diplomacy, social engagement, and creating communities that empower others. I am always looking for the next big project to strengthen my skills and create lasting connections.
